On delivered page 20 (Statement of Inability page 11 of 12, the Option 1 declaration under penalty of perjury) the packet writes the name and the address and leaves the three date-of-birth boxes empty, in BOTH fixtures. The same fact is written nine pages earlier, on delivered page 11: '1994-04-17' in canonical, '1972-12-31' in boundary. reports/blanks-left-for-the-participant.json puts all three boxes - 'Month / Mes', 'Day / Dia', 'Year / Ano' - in protectedBlanks with label 'Date part of the sworn declaration' and why 'a date written before the Statement is actually sworn would be false'.
